cohort: The study included 378 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM group) and 200 pregnant women with normal blood glucose (NGT group) awaiting delivery in Weifang People's hospital.
finding: Age, pre-pregnancy BMI, family history of diabetes, 2hPBG, and HbA1c were identified as independent risk factors for GDM, and GDM was significantly associated with a higher incidence of adverse maternal and fetal pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The incidence of dystocia and cesarean section was significantly higher in the GDM group compared to the normal control group.
